messages.subject: [Ad] advanced lavaan course in Lisbon (May 3-5)
parts:
Statscamp is coming to Europe (Lisbon) in May, see:

https://www.statscamp.org/euro-camp

One of the courses is 'Structural Equation Modeling With lavaan' (May
3-5), taught by myself. The course will feature the upcoming 0.6 version
of lavaan and will include a section on multilevel SEM.

There seems to be a hefty discount if you take two courses.

Please forward this to anyone who might be interested.

Yves.
